name: Arby's
src: Arby's Nutrition & Allergen Information (U.S.), NOV 2026 edition. Allergens are the guide's Contains / May contain lists; items marked as made in a facility that handles peanuts or tree nuts have those as may-contain, and fried sides cooked in shared oil have the oil's allergens as may-contain, and milk from the buttered buns a few markets use is may-contain. Drinks are with 50% ice fill. Left out: bottled water and items the guide repeats in the Kids and Value menus; 1 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros (Mello Yello (medium)).
